title: Stage 1 Deterministic Invariants
description: Machine-enforced rules for the semantic validator (SKILL.md §7) and evidence sufficiency validator. Every invariant here must be checkable without visual judgment — if a rule requires looking at the image to decide, it does not belong in this file (see SKILL.md §7 boundary note and §12 on not hardcoding subjective thresholds).

invariants.description: A slide_role value must be a member of taxonomy_bindings.slide_role_registry.canonical, and must never be a member of taxonomy_bindings.primitive_registry.canonical.
A primitive_type value must be a member of taxonomy_bindings.primitive_registry.canonical, and must never be a member of taxonomy_bindings.slide_role_registry.canonical.
A primitive's declared zone must be a member of taxonomy_bindings.zone_registry.canonical.
Every evidence_refs entry must resolve to an object_id that exists in the same harness's visual_observations.json.

An inference (slide_role, novel-candidate proposal, anchor claim, comparison claim) with an empty evidence_refs array. Does not require a minimum count — only presence and resolvability, per the no-hardcoded-thresholds rule.
A persistent-anchor claim with no evidence_refs identifying the frames/observations supporting persistence.
object_id values must be unique within a harness's observation set.
The recorded syntax_hash must equal a fresh canonicalization of the same syntax fields. If they disagree, the canonicalizer or the record is broken — surface, do not silently trust either.

The number of unique entries in deduplication_summary must equal the number of distinct syntax_hash values across all slide analyses in the harness — not the number of distinct layout_fingerprint strings.

A taxonomy item may only carry state CANONICAL if it is present in the relevant contracts/taxonomy_bindings.json canonical list. A NOVEL_CANDIDATE state must never be silently rewritten to CANONICAL within Stage 1 execution — promotion is a separate, explicit, out-of-band taxonomy-registry update event.
source_zip_sha256_recorded must equal source_zip_sha256_observed_now. This is a technical-integrity check only — see SKILL.md §0 and §3. It carries no licensing or usability implication.
vision_model_used/base_url differ from the documented default pipeline. Must be recorded as deviation_from_documented_pipeline: true and surfaced in the contract report.

lifecycle_rule.description: The single hard rule gating STAGE1_COMPLETE. Enforced in code — see SKILL.md §8 and Regression Case 10.
lifecycle_rule.notes: technical_status of BLOCKED or FAIL can never reach STAGE1_COMPLETE regardless of operator_disposition. technical_status of REVIEW CAN reach STAGE1_COMPLETE on APPROVE — REVIEW is the expected shape of a well-evidenced novel candidate, not a defect (see SKILL.md §8, §10).
